standard-dialogue-avium-savannah-trio-gr.player: Hey there. What are you lot doing out here?

standard-dialogue-avium-savannah-trio-gr.npc: We're from the College of Bards in Tempestus. We thought we'd set up camp here to do some performances for anyone travelling through the savannah.
With the kingdom now open to tourists, we've had plenty of new fans!

standard-dialogue-avium-savannah-trio-tr.npc: Thanks! I made it myself. The College of Bards insist that we all have the ability to create and maintain our own instruments. I'm quite proud of what I came up with!

standard-dialogue-avium-savannah-trio-tr.player: Well I hope it serves you well.

standard-dialogue-avium-savannah-trio-ma.npc: Think you've got what it takes to join the College of Bards?
Well it only takes a lifetime of practice, so maybe give it a go one day.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.player: Hi there. Are you enjoying the view?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.npc: I am, though I do wish it would be blocked by the ferry to Tempestus.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.player: The ferry? Is there something wrong with it?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.npc: I'm not sure exactly. All I know is that it's not running at the moment.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.player: How urgently do you need to get there?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.npc: We should be back at the College of Bards already, but I'm sure they'll understand why we got delayed.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.player: Oh, you're a bard? Could you sing for me?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-on.npc: Maybe. Can you take us to Temptestus?
Then I'm afraid you don't get any singing this time.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.npc: Nilsal! Have you come to hear a song from the Sister Songstresses of the College of Bards?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.player: Sister Songstresses? So you're a group of sisters who sing together?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.npc: Don't be silly! Of course we aren't!

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.player: Oh... The name did suggest otherwise...

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.npc: Well, we realised when we met that we were all very similar, so we've been using it as a selling point! Everyone loves Snappy Sister, Stormy Sister, and of course me, Spirited Sister!
People love a nice story about a trio of sisters coming together! So yes, it works rather well.
It's all storytelling! Songs, appearance, history. We're telling a story and people want to hear it!

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.player: I'm not sure if people wanting to hear it makes it entirely ethical.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.npc: Is it made better if our songs are good?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.player: Now that you mention it... no of course it isn't.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-spirit.npc: Well, you're just no fun, iknami.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-li.player: You seem a little down. What's up?

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-li.npc: I just want to get back to the College of Bards. It's like my spark has gone out being away from such a creative environment.

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-li.player: I'm sure you'll be back there before long.
It doesn't hurt to be hopeful, does it? Not to mention, hope can be a great inspiration!

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-li.npc: Hope can be a great inspiration... Perfect! I'll use that!

standard-dialogue-tal-teklan-trio-the-li.player: Oh... Well, I'm happy to have helped.
